# A static method reached through a value is reported wherever it was
# declared. `ir.Func.Pkg` is empty for a declaration a sibling directory wrote
# as much as for one this file did -- it names a `sngl:` tier and nothing else
# -- so the check needs no second case for an imported package, and this says
# so with the real import resolver rather than the checker harness's stub.

! sngl check .
stderr 'Point.zero is static: it declares no parameters'

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import d "./geom"

component main node {
    var p d.Point = d.Point{x = 1}

    text(value=string(p.zero()))
}

window {
    main
}
-- geom/geom.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Point {
    x int = 0
}

func Point.zero() => 7
